notes: Advanced: one skeleton, p sqrt(cos a) - q (sin b)^2. The angle a is drawn only from angles whose cosine is positive (first and fourth quadrant, so the root exists; 305 degrees is the book's own fourth-quadrant angle); b is drawn from all four quadrants, and squaring removes the sign, which is the twist. Ratio and root values are tabulated (integers over 10^10, exact) because the expression language has no sin/cos/tan; AC, CAC, SQC are index-aligned and ANG, SIN are index-aligned.
